name: POST /api/voice-agent/calls/:call_id/complete - Report the end of a call
description: The voice runtime reports a finished call once: status (completed|failed), optional disposition (runtime/carrier outcome, e.g. no_answer, voicemail — it takes precedence), answered_by (human|machine|unknown), turns [{turn_index, speaker caller|agent|system, text, started_ms, stt_ms, ttft_ms, ttfa_ms, interrupted, tool_calls}], started_at/answered_at/ended_at, duration_s, cost_breakdown (merged), recording_ref, recording_consent, carrier_call_ref, crm_encounter_id, conversation_thread_id. Turns are upserted; the summary and disposition come from the tenant's own llm_complex model via sdk-ai-gateway, falling back to an extractive summary (post_call.summary_source). The call is then mirrored (ebd2f4af-72a1-4e29-b56f-a13d1c1a8b84#AC3 — a completed call appears on the subject's conversation thread and CRM activity timeline): each non-system turn becomes a VOICE message on the subject's open thread (INBOUND/RECEIVED for the caller, OUTBOUND/DELIVERED for the agent), and the encounter's CRM timeline gets one call activity (external_call_id voice-agent:<call_id>). Repeating the same report is idempotent; voice.call.completed.v1 is emitted once. Returns the call detail (ebd2f4af-72a1-4e29-b56f-a13d1c1a8b84#AC2). The runner cannot place a call (see POST /api/voice-agent/calls), so testCases[0] exercises the 404; the 200 path is proven end-to-end.

errorCases.message: status must be completed or failed | disposition must be one of connected_qualified, connected_not_interested, callback_requested, meeting_booked, voicemail, no_answer, busy, wrong_number, opt_out, failed | answered_by must be human, machine or unknown | turns[i].speaker must be caller, agent or system | turns[i].turn_index N is duplicated | cost_breakdown must be a JSON object | crm_encounter_id does not reference an encounter of this tenant

errorCases.when: no such call for the authenticated tenant
